value.message: Select the instances you want to connect.
Each selected instance will establish trust with this instance and share its clone data.
The following instances will be connected:
This may take several minutes and will complete in the background. Once finished, clone data from all connected instances will appear on the Clone Activity and Instance Overview pages.
You can check status anytime under Configuration > Multi-Instance View > Connected Instances.
Multi-Instance View unlocks consolidated information showing clone activity across all instances, last clone timestamps, and enhanced management features.
Turn on to view consolidated clone activity across all connected instances
Once instances are connected, their clone activity will be displayed on your Clone Activity page.

When you disable Multi-Instance View, all previously configured trust settings will be removed. To restore trust, you will need to re-enable Multi-Instance View and select the desired instances again.

Do you want to continue?
